name: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering with Z-Slice Packing
definition: A volume rendering technique that stores a 3D volume as a 2D texture composed of a grid of Z-slices, allowing 3D sampling via 2D texture lookups and trilinear interpolation.
summary: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering with Z-Slice Packing renders 3D scalar fields by storing Z-slices in a tiled 2D texture grid, differing from standard 3D sampling by mapping coordinates to a 2D atlas for hardware compatibility.
